Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner imposed an incorrect constraint to consider only officially credited directors and pre-assumed Monster A Go-Go’s sole director as Bill Rebane (b. 1937), ignoring Herschell Gordon Lewis (b. 1926), who is widely recognized as co-director. This misframing would lead to the wrong comparison (favoring The Gamecock’s director b. 1927) instead of the correct answer, Monster A Go-Go.
